items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: George Shearing of course... he saw the bigger opportunity this side of the Atlantic

ctx.x: And that’s what he wanted to do. And he found I think the London scene, to a degree, restricting. And like a number of other English players, George Shearing of course, Derek Smith would be others, Marian McPartland you mentioned, he saw the bigger opportunity this side of the Atlantic, New York in particular being the focal point as he saw it, I’m sure that was justified. And I know because I spoke to him in the last year that he feels that it was a wholly good move. And who’s to say he was wrong? As he sees it…
How did you fall in love with the music?
